label: B
question: What is the study design described in the SAP?
answer:
**Study design described in the SAP** The Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) for Study D1680C00019 outlines a **Phase 3b, multicenter, randomized, double‑blind, parallel‑group, placebo‑controlled trial** in pediatric patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Key elements of the design are: | Feature | Description | |---------|-------------| | **Population** | Children and adolescents aged 10–17 years with T2DM | | **Intervention** | Saxagliptin 2.5 mg (pooled with 5 mg) versus placebo | | **Primary endpoint** | Change in HbA1c from baseline to Week 26 | | **Study periods** | • 6‑month screening
• 2‑week lead‑in
• 26‑week short‑term (ST) treatment period
• 26‑week long‑term (LT) period
• 28‑day follow‑up
• 104‑week post‑study visit | | **Randomization** | • Day 1: 1:1 randomization to placebo or saxa 2.5 mg (stratified by baseline antidiabetic medication, sex, and age group)
• Week 14: second randomization for patients with HbA1c ≥ 7 % at Week 12 (1:1 to continue low‑dose or up‑titrate to 5 mg) | | **Blinding** | Double‑blind (participants, investigators, and study staff) | | **Analysis population** | Modified intent‑to‑treat (mITT) with multiple‑imputation washout (MI‑WO) for missing data | These details are taken directly from the SAP section of the clinical study report: the study is described as a Phase 3b, multicenter, randomized, placebo‑controlled, double‑blind, parallel‑group design with the above timelines and randomization scheme [Doc doc_e2842eeb2cb3 (Page 8, Section 3.2.1)] and summarized in Table 2 of the report [Doc doc_e2842eeb2cb3 (Page 7, Section Table 2)].
